planning_note: 原版IP两镜头准备示例。没有生成图片或视频；每段5秒是策划值，运行前按目标平台核验。先运行prepare_original_pack.py取得实际原图与提示，再登记真实首帧。

shots.prompt_zh: Bit东保持原版造型，露出克制而自然的微笑，抬起右手打招呼，结束时右手保持抬起。中景，镜头缓慢推进，柔和正面光。
shots.prompt_en: Bit Dong gives a small, natural smile and raises his right hand in greeting, ending with his hand raised. Medium shot with a slow push-in and soft frontal light. Preserve the original character design.
shots.frame_prompt_zh: 原版Bit东在简洁2D工作室内面向镜头。中景，双手自然放下；保持原版脸型、发型、眼镜、服装和画风。
shots.frame_prompt_en: The original Bit Dong character faces the camera in a minimal 2D studio. Medium shot, hands relaxed at his sides. Match the original face, hairstyle, glasses, outfit, and rendering.

shots.prompt_zh: 承接上镜头，Bit东从右手抬起的姿势开始，自然放下右手，再轻轻点头，最后保持平静微笑。镜头固定，保持同一工作室、光线及原版人物。
shots.prompt_en: Continue from the raised right hand. Bit Dong lowers it naturally, gives a small nod, and settles into a relaxed smile. Locked camera, same studio, lighting, and original character design.
shots.frame_prompt_zh: 同一原版Bit东、同一工作室，中近景；右手已经抬起准备承接上一镜头。保持相同服饰、脸部与光线。
shots.frame_prompt_en: Same original Bit Dong character and studio, in a medium close-up. His right hand is already raised to continue the previous shot. Keep the face, outfit, and lighting consistent.
